# ScreenHarmony Flex v2.8.5

### 🚀 Key Features & Highlights
- **Smart Remote Wake-Up System**: Added proactive wake-up commands before locking offline child devices.
- **1-Minute Freshness Check**: Prevents redundant wake-up transmissions when target devices are already recently synced and active.
- **Parent Alert Dialogs & Instant Signals**: Real-time signal indicators for online status and immediate error feedback dialogs on connection failures.
- **Circular Start Action Icon**: Refined quick-action UI for offline child device management across parent overview and contextual cards.

### 🛡️ Resilience & Performance
- Improved FCM payload handling and real-time database signal delivery.
- Enhanced battery and wake-lock optimization for managed child endpoints.
